adjudication.rationale: In this diff, `refreshOAuthTokens()` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` are truthy. In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token is assigned as `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, but there is no parsing of the `Response` body into a `HubspotToken` shape. That means in sync mode the code will receive a `Response` where later code expects token fields (e.g., expiry/access token), leading to undefined/NaN behavior. The finding’s broader claim about persisting the Response/overwriting refresh tokens is plausible but not fully verifiable from the shown hunk, however the core type/behavior mismatch in sync mode is directly evidenced by the diff.
